GALACTIC
June 25, 1999
Canoe Place Inn
Bridgehampton, NY

DSBD > DAT
Transferred by Adam Rosenberg


Charlie Dozen
Church > 
Doublewide
Crazyhorse Mongoose
Get Ready
Start from Scratch
Action Speaks Louder Than Words
Thrill
??
Baker's Dozen
Love On the Run
Get Out My Life Woman
My Mind Is Hazy
Groovy Lady (w extended Stanton solo)
-encore break-
Cissy Strut (cut)


back in 1999 a few weeks after their two-night stand at Irving Plaza (their first?), the band headed out east on Long Island to a little bar out in the Hamptons. it was a very light turnout, probably just 20-30 people. i was a giant Galactic nerd and i had met the guys at Irving, so i chatted them up (mostly Ben) before and after the show.

jumping ahead a few weeks, i dropped Ben an email to see if the band had recorded the show since there weren't any tapers in the house that night. they did, and he kindly sent me the DAT. i definitely shared the ripped recording as widely as i could way back when, but it's not like there was abundant high speed internet at the time.

so here it is! the sound is as crisp and clear as you'd expect from a SBD, if a little unbalanced. the levels jump around a bit in the opening minutes. the only tragedy here is they busted out Cissy Strut for the encore, but only a couple minutes were captured. killer show overall though, with a lot of exploratory jams and some classic Houseman moments. i pulled this off the original CDs i made from the DAT (which hasn't yet been found).
